title: 눈같이 하얀 얼굴: 무엇과 비슷해요?
objective: By the end, you can attach 같이 to a noun to say what something is like, swap it with 처럼, and tell it apart from 같은 and 같이 meaning "together."
summary: Learn the particle 같이, which compares one thing to another ("like, as ... as") and works the same way as 처럼.

task.title: Use 같이 correctly
task.line: Choose, fill in, rewrite, or correct each item using the rules on page 1.

forms.when: Attach 같이 directly to the noun, with no space. The shape never changes, with or without a final consonant (batchim).
forms.exampleMeaning: My grandmother smiles like a young girl.

forms.when: In comparisons, 같이 and 처럼 mean the same thing, so you can swap them. 처럼 is a little more common in speech.
forms.exampleMeaning: My hands are as cold as ice.

forms.when: Before a noun, do not use the particle 같이. Use 같은, written with a space.
forms.exampleMeaning: Today the weather is like spring.

watchOut: 눈 같이 하얀 (X) → 눈같이 하얀 (O): When 같이 means "like," it is a particle, so write it attached to the noun.
천사같이 사람 (X) → 천사 같은 사람 (O): Before a noun, use 같은, not 같이.
친구같이 영화를 봤어요 (X) → 친구와 같이 영화를 봤어요 (O): To say "together with," use 와/과 or 하고 + 같이, written with a space.
exercises: Choose the correct spelling: 우리 아기 볼이 (사과같이 / 사과 같이) 빨개요.
Fill in each blank with 같이 or 같은: ① 그 사람은 가수____ 노래를 잘해요. ② 저도 가수 ____ 목소리를 갖고 싶어요.
Does 같이 mean "like" or "together"? ① 어머니와 같이 시장에 갔어요. ② 우리 선생님은 어머니같이 따뜻하세요. ③ 그 아이는 어른같이 말해요.
Rewrite the sentence using 같이 instead of 처럼: 친구 집이 호텔처럼 깨끗해요.
Find the mistake and correct it: 오늘은 한여름 같이 더워요.
Complete the sentence with the word in brackets + 같이: (꿀) 이 수박은 ____ 달아요.
answers: ① together ② like ③ like
